parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left handle switch of the faucet, made of brass, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow by rotating the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of brass, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the internal plumbing to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right handle switch of the faucet, made of brass, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow by rotating the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Bolt (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is a bolt component used to secure the faucet parts together, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural stability and holds the faucet assembly in place.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed once tightened and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame (Spout Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the spout, made of brass, providing support and connection to the sink.
parts.Functional_description: It stabilizes the spout and connects it to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Frame (Right Handle Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the right handle, made of brass, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the right handle in place and connects it to the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Frame (Left Handle Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the left handle, made of brass, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the left handle in place and connects it to the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.
